simple.meaning: עֹלָה (ʻôlâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a step or (collectively, stairs, as ascending); usually a holocaust (as going up in smoke).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 289 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, beginning at Genesis 8:20. Its contexts include family, family line, offering, altar, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֹלָה (H5930).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עֹלָה (ʻôlâh) / H5930 is traced through Genesis 8:20, Genesis 22:2, Genesis 22:3, Genesis 22:6 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H5930. olah I. עֹלָה 286 noun feminine whole burnt-offering ( that which goes up ( √ 6 ) to heaven (al. on altar)); — ׳ע Gen 22:3 141t.; עוֺלָה Numbers 28:37 33t.; construct עֹלַת Exod 29:42 27 t., עוֺלַת Num 28:24 2 t.; suffix עוֺלָֽתְךּ Psa 20:4 , etc.; plural עֹלוֺת Josh 8:31 42t., עֹלֹת Gen 8:20 3 t.; עוֺלֹת Deut 27:6 , עוֺלוֺת Amos 5:22 +; suffix עֹלוֺתֵיבֶם Jer 6:20 +, etc.; — the whole burnt-offering (beast or fowl) is entirely consumed and goes up i the flame of the altar to God expressing the ascent of the soul in worship. All of the victim is laid on the altar except the hide and such parts as could not be washed clean. If beast the ׳ע must be a male without blemish Lev 1:3 , 10 ; 22:18-19 , of herd or flock; if of flock, either sheep or goad; if fowl, either turtle-dove or young pigeon 1:14 , the latter usually offered by the poor 5:7 ; 12:8 ; 14:22 ; 15:14-15 , 29 , 30 ; Num 6:10 ; 6:11 . A lamb was offered by individuals Lev 12:6 ; Num 6:14 , and by the nation at the עֹמֶר offering Lev 23:12 , and daily at the הַכֹּקֶר עֹלַת 9:17 ; Num 28:23 ; 2Kin 16:15 ; Ezek 46:13 , and at morning and evening תמיד עלח Num 28:3 , עֹלַת (הַ)תָּמִיד Exod 29:42 ; Num 28:6 , 10 , 15 , 23 , 24 , 31 ; 29:6 , 11 , 16 , 19 , 22 , 25 , 28 , 31 , 34 , 38 ; Ezra 3:5 ; Neh Neh 10:34 ; Ezek 46:13 . These were doubled at the שַׁכָּת עֹלַת Num 28:10 . A ram was offered by Aaron and his sons Exod 29:28 ; Lev 8:18 ; 9:2 ; 16:3 , 5 ; but a young bullock was of greater value Num 15:8 , 24 ; 2Sam 24:22 = 1Chr 21:23 , at consecration of Levites Num 8:12 , socalves Micah 6:6 ; on great occasions bullocks + rams Num 23:1-6 , 14 , 15 , bullocks + rams + lambs Isa 1:11 ; one of each kind offered by tribal chiefs Num 7:15 , 21 , 27 , 33 , 39 , 45 , 51 , 57 , 63 , 69 , 75, 81, 87. In ritual of (ה)חֹדֶשׁ עֹלַת 28:14 ; 29:6 and at מצּות and Pentecost 2 bullocks, 1 ram, and 7 lambs were added to daily offering 28:11 , 19 , 27 ; at offering of new bread at Pentecost 1bullock, 2 rams, and 7 lambs Lev 23:18 on the 1st and 10th of the 7th month and at עצרת 1bullock, 1 ram, and 7 lambs, in addition to the offerings of new moon Num 29:2 , 8 , 36 ; the system culminated in 70 bullocks, 14 rams, 98 lambs for the 7 days of Tabernacles 29:13 ff. Acc to Ezek. the prince was to offer on each of 7 days of מצות 7bullocks and 7 rams Ezek 45:23 , and on Sabbath 6 lambs and 1 ram 46:4 . At the reconsecration of temple 70 bullocks, 100 rams, and 200 lambs were offered 2Chr 29:32 , and at the return of exiles 12 bullocks, 96 rams, and 77 lambs Ezra 8:35 . In early times whole burnt-offerings of children were sometimes made, e.g. Jephthah's daughter Judg 11:31 ; Isaac proposed as, Gen 22:2 but ram substituted 22:13 ; made to other gods 2Kin 3:27 ; Jer 19:5 +. The ׳ע was anciently made on any altar used for worship, but in P confined to הָעֹלָה מִזְבַּח Exod 30:28 ; 31:9 ; 35:16 ; 38:1 ; 40:6 , 10 , 29 ; Lev 4:7 , 10 , 18 , 25 (twice in verse); 4:30 , 34 ; 1Chr 6:40 ; 21:26 , 29 ; 2Chr 29:18 (not in other literature); לעלה מזבח Josh 22:29 ; 1Chr 22:1 . The offerer imposed his hands on head of animal, then slaughtered it Lev 1:4-5 , ע ׳שׁחט 4:24 , 33 ; 6:8 ; 7:2 ; 9:12 ; 14:13 , 19 , 31 ; Ezek 40:39 , 42 ; 44:11 , and flayed it ע ׳הַפְשִׁיט Lev 1:6 ; 2Chr 29:34 . The priest washed the pieces Ezek 40:38 ; arranged them on the altar above the wood Lev 6:5 ; the fire devoured them 6:2-6 ; 9:24 ; 1Kin 18:38 ; 2Chr 7:1 , they went up in the flame ליהוה ניחח ריח (ל) Lev 1:9 , 13 , 17 ; 8:21 ; Num 28:13 ; לְרָצוֺן , according to character of offerer Isa 56:7 ; Jer 6:20 ; see also Psa 20:4 ; 40:7 ; 51:18 ; 1Sam 15:22 .Phrases: ע ׳העלה Gen 8:20 ; Exod 32:6 (J) 24:5 (E) 30:9 ; 40:29 ; Lev 14:20 ; 17:8 (P) Deut 12:13-14 , 27:6 ; Josh 8:31 ; 22:23 ; Judg 6:26 ; 20:26 ; 21:4 ; 1Sam 6:14-15 , 7:9-10 , 10:8 ; 13:9-10 , 12 ; 2Sam 6:17-18 , 24:24-25 , 1Kin 3:4 , 15 ; 9:25 ; 10:5 ; 2Kin 3:27 ; 1Chr 16:2 , 40 ; 21:24 , 26 ; 23:31 ; 29:21 ; 2Chr 1:6 ; 8:12 ; 9:4 ; 23:18 ; 24:14 ; 29:7 , 27 ; 35:14 , 16 ; Ezra 3:2-3 , 6 ; Job 1:5 ; 42:8 ; Psa 66:15 ; Jer 14:12 ; 33:18 ; Ezek 43:18 , 24 ; Amos 5:22 (compare העלה 9 ); ע ׳זבח Exod 20:24 (E); לע ׳עשׂה Lev 23:12 ; Num 6:11 ; 15:24 ; 29:39 ; ע ׳עָשָׂה Lev 5:10 ; 9:7 , 22 ; 15:15 , 30 ; 16:24 (twice in verse); Num 6:16 ; 8:12 ; 15:3 , 8 ; 29:2 ; Deut 12:27 ; Judg 13:16 ; 1Kin 8:64 ; 2Kin 5:17 ; 10:24-25 , 2Chr 7:7 ; Ezek 43:27 ; 45:17 , 23 ; 46:2 , 12 (twice in verse); 46:13 ; ע ׳הִקְרִיב Lev 7:8 ; 9:16 ; 10:19 ; 23:37 ; Num 28:3 , 11 , 19 , 27 ; 29:8 , 13 , 36 ; 1Chr 16:1 ; Ezra 8:35 ; Ezek 46:4 ; לע ׳הקריב Lev 22:18 ; Num 6:14 ; ע ׳הביא Deut 12:6 , 11 ; 2Chr 29:31-32 , 30:15 ; Isa 43:23 ; Jer 17:26 ; ע ׳הקטְיר 2Kin 16:13 , 15 ; 2Chr 13:11 . — עוֺלוֺת עֹלָתָה, see also עַוְלָה below I. עוּל . II. [ עֹלָה ] noun feminine ascent, stairway , עלותו Ezek 40:26 Kt, עֹלוֺתָיו Qr; read probably מַעֲלָתוֺ ( ᵐ5 Co SS לוֺ , Toy עֹלָתוֺ ).
